title: Grand Bahia Principe, Runaway Bay & Ocho Rios, Jamaica
description: Aerial drone tour of the hotel and surrounding area in Runaway Bay, Jamaica.  We left the hotel on an excursion to the Blue Hole near Ocho Rios.  While there, I was able to get footage of the town and cruise dock with a ship in port.  Added a time lapse of our drive and some photos of those on the trip
